heading: CHAPTER XI.
title: CONCERNING ECCLESIASTICAL PRINCIPALITIES
exclusions: front matter and dedication before THE PRINCE
notes: Chapter 11 is an exception chapter: ecclesiastical principalities are hard to gain but easy to hold because ancient religious ordinances sustain them beyond ordinary political rules.
Machiavelli still gives a concrete political history for the Church's temporal growth, especially through Alexander VI and Julius II.
The chapter must preserve both its oddity and its historical mechanism without flattening religion into a generic brand or institution.
